contentPacks.description: `true` ⇒ the host instantiates registered form templates. Normative consequences (`form-content-packs.md` §"Instantiation"): create through the SAME path a hand-authored form uses; degrade an unrecognized field type to a plain text input rather than failing; keep the instantiated form fully editable; execute nothing from the pack; sanitize/validate/authorize submissions exactly as hand-typed input. Pack-authored strings are UNTRUSTED and MUST propagate `meta.contentTrust: "untrusted"` into interpolated prompt segments (invariant `form-content-pack-string-trust-boundary`) — a signature proves authorship, not content safety.
